body.text: Travis Young is the CIO (Chief Information Officer) of Systematic Power Solutions, abbreviated SPS.
Systematic Power Solutions (SPS) owns these brands: XS Power, Sundown Audio, Ampere Audio, Lithium Pros, and Turbostart.

BoBClaw is a four-service multi-agent orchestration platform made of bobclaw-core (LangGraph), bobclaw-gateway (auth and chat), bobclaw-claude-pipeline (Claude build sessions), and a Kotlin Multiplatform app.
The BoBClaw memory module embeds text with a llama.cpp granite-311m server running on port 8081, not LM Studio.
